name: npkill
title: Npkill
description: Discover development artifacts with npkill, review project activity and risk, and clean selected directories.
author: 0xdhrv

commands.name: scan-artifacts
commands.title: Scan Development Artifacts
commands.subtitle: npkill
commands.description: Find development dependencies, build artifacts, and caches using npkill profiles; review and clean selected directories.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1

preferences.name: sortOrder
preferences.title: Default Sort Order
preferences.description: Initial sort order for development artifacts.

tools.name: search-artifacts
tools.title: Search Development Artifacts
tools.description: Scan for development artifacts with npkill and filter by path, size, inactivity, or risk. Read-only; reports estimates and incomplete results.

tools.name: check-setup
tools.title: Check Npkill Setup
tools.description: Check npkill and Node compatibility, the saved root, profiles, and scan settings without scanning or changing files.

tools.name: open-cleanup
tools.title: Open Cleanup Command
tools.description: Open the native Scan Development Artifacts command for user review and confirmation. Does not select, move, or delete files.
